questions.Description:
a) Write a Java program to read the temperature in Celsius and convert into Fahrenheit.
b) Write a Java program for method over loading.

a) Write a Java program to compute the factorial of a number.
b) Write a Java program for Constructor over loading.

a) Write a Java program to find the sum and average of your tenth standard marks.
b) Write a Java program to create a class called Vehicle with a method called drive(). Create
a subclass called Car that over rides the drive() method to print "Repairing a car".

a) Write a Java program to multiply two matrices.
b) Write a Java program that creates a class hierarchy for employees of a company. The
base class should be Employee, with subclasses Manager, Developer, and Programmer.
Each subclass should have properties such as name, address, salary, and job title.
Implement methods for calculating bonuses, generating performance reports, and
managing projects.

a) Write a Java program to find the Fibonacci series using recursive and non-recursive
functions.
b) Write a Java program that simulates a traffic light. The program lets the user select one
of three lights: red, yellow, or green with radio buttons. On selecting a button, an
appropriate message with “Stop” or “Ready” or “Go” should appear above the buttons in
selected color. Initially, there is no message shown.
